name: Underfed
description: Moves a channel off a source that is starving it, drifting its sound, missing whole stretches, looping on corrupt packets or refusing it: to the next source when the stream arrives at a fraction of its bitrate, with its timestamps apart, with holes in its picture or sound or forcing reconnect after reconnect, to the back of the chain when the provider answers 403 or closes the connection without sending a byte.
author: PilaScat
